Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misclassification of what constitutes a scientific hypothesis. The Planner incorrectly selected A (a claim of established fact) and dismissed D, even though D is a specific, testable prediction—the proper form of a scientific hypothesis. This reflects a misunderstanding of hypothesis criteria and a premature conclusion without systematically validating each option against the definition.
